about: The runbook catalog make remediate reads (commands/remediate.py, workshop lesson 10.11), one row per alert policy the
kit's Terraform declares, keyed by the policy's display name: the name an incident and its e-mail carry. A row adds
only what the policy itself lacks: the Cloud Run services it watches, the lines remediate reads as its evidence, and
whether remediate may propose the one action it knows (a rollback, when a revision created inside the window fails
where the revision before it did not) or the policy is a person's to act on, with the reason. The runbook's text
stays where it is written, in the policy's documentation block, and remediate prints it from there: one home, so it
cannot drift. commands/tests/test_remediate.py fails when a policy has no row, a row names no policy, or a row's
evidence reads an event or a value the policy's own metric does not.

silent.label: 5xx answers
silent.what: requests a service answered with a 5xx status, from Cloud Run's request log
silent.why: no alert policy the kit declares counts a service's 5xx answers

silent.label: chat turns stopped by a limit
silent.what: documind-chat turns ended by one of their limits (limits.stopped_by on the chat row, workshop lesson 5.5)
silent.why: every chat row carries stopped_by and no policy counts it yet: an agent alert policy is designed for after 6 December

policies.policy: documind-slm left warm: instances > 0 for 2 hours
policies.person: the runbook's own step, make off, is for when no session is running, which only a person knows

evidence.reads: container instance_count, a Cloud Monitoring gauge remediate does not read

policies.policy: documind-vllm left warm: instances > 0 for 2 hours
policies.person: the runbook's own step, make off, is for when no session is running, which only a person knows

evidence.reads: container instance_count, a Cloud Monitoring gauge remediate does not read

policies.policy: Ledger drift above zero for two nights
policies.person: the ledger against the uploads bucket, not a revision: make reconcile prints the plan, and a person applies it

evidence.reads: the nightly job's reconcile_done lines over 24 hours, not a service's

policies.person: a job's run, not a service's revision: a person reads the execution's logs and runs it again

evidence.reads: a Cloud Run job's failed task attempts, a Cloud Monitoring metric

policies.person: an upload the worker refused twelve times: a person reads it, fixes or removes the object, then acknowledges it

evidence.reads: a Pub/Sub subscription's undelivered messages, a Cloud Monitoring gauge

policies.policy: Ingest subscription backlog: oldest message over 30 minutes
policies.person: a queue, not a revision: a person reads what the worker logs and whether it answers, and a busy worker drains on its own

evidence.reads: a Pub/Sub subscription's oldest unacknowledged message age, a Cloud Monitoring gauge

policies.policy: Desk router: fallback share above 1% for a tenant
Desk router: L2 share above its 15% cap for a tenant
policies.person: the router's thresholds decide it, and a change to TAU_OOS or ACCEPT_VOTES is a reviewed commit

policies.policy: Desk router: clarify or out_of_scope up more than 5 points week on week
policies.person: a change in what people ask, over two weeks: the router's examples or a desk's switches, a person's call

evidence.reads: two weeks of the router's turns, not an hour's

policies.policy: Desk case queue: a case due within 24 hours and unacknowledged, or breached
policies.person: a case is its queue's people's to act on, and a sensitive queue's committee or contact's alone

evidence.reads: the hourly overdue job's lines, which name a queue and a count

policies.policy: A registered document arrived at a version nobody reviewed
policies.person: a person reads the new version before the pin follows it

Desk gate check: a door could not read which tenants are on
